purpose_context: Authors bringing Leanpub-authored Markdown into doc-kitty hit constructs that plain Markdown ignores (asides, callouts, figure images, crosslink ids, icons). This mission adds opt-in support for a curated Markua subset through Astro's remark/rehype extension points, so those pages render as intended while every existing plain-Markdown page renders exactly as before.
purpose_tldr: Render a practical subset of Leanpub's Markua Markdown correctly in the docsite, without changing how plain Markdown renders.
